Purr.title: Purring
Purr.meaning: Usually relaxed and content. Cats also purr to calm themselves when stressed or hurt, so check the rest of its body language.

Hiss.title: Hissing
Hiss.meaning: Scared or defensive. Give it space and don't reach for it.

Caterwaul.title: Yowling
Caterwaul.meaning: A long, intense call. Often a standoff with another cat or a mating call; it can also mean distress.

I: I don't know this place. Where are you?
